mapper.select: SELECT * FROM org_department WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_department (id, parent_id, tree_path, dept_code, dept_name, dept_type, dept_level, leader_user_id, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{parentId}, #{treePath}, #{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{deptType}, #{deptLevel}, #{leaderUserId}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE org_department SET parent_id = #{parentId}, tree_path = #{treePath}, dept_code = #{deptCode}, dept_name = #{deptName}, dept_type = #{deptType}, dept_level = #{deptLevel}, leader_user_id = #{leaderUserId}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(), is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE org_department SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org_department WHERE dept_code = #{deptCode} AND (#{exceptId} IS NULL OR id <> #{exceptId}) AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM org_department WHERE tree_path LIKE CONCAT(#{treePath}, '%') AND id <> #{exceptId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY dept_level ASC, id ASC
